name: Maryland
basePeriod: The first four of the last five completed calendar quarters before your claim. Maryland uses the four most recent completed quarters only if those do not qualify.

dependentAllowances.note: $8 a week for each child under 16 you support, up to five, never past the $430 maximum.

notModeled: The alternate base period: enter whichever four quarters the Department will use.

citation.sourceDocument: Md. Code, Lab. & Empl. §§8-802, 8-803, 8-804, 8-808 (schedule of benefits)
citation.sourceNote: §8-803(b), the schedule of benefits: 381 lines in $24 bands of high-quarter wages, from "(1) $ 1,176.01 to $ 1,200.00 50.00 1,800.00" to "(381) $10,296.01 and over 430.00 15,480.00", each line's minimum qualifying wages 1.5 times its upper limit (§8-802). Short of it, a claimant who qualifies "in 1 of the next 6 lower lines" gets the lower line's amount (§8-803(a)(2)). §8-804: "$8 for each child", not "for more than 5 dependents", benefits and allowance not exceeding the schedule's highest amount. §8-808: the total is 26 times the weekly amount, the allowance paid on top. The 2026 bill to change the formula (SB 3) did not pass. Read 2026-10-19.
